changes.title: TCPA and ADA federal lawsuits by district first published
changes.summary: One row for each of the 94 federal district courts, fiscal year and code: civil cases filed under nature-of-suit code 485 (Telephone Consumer Protection Act, fiscal years 2019 to 2025) and code 446 (Americans with Disabilities Act, other, fiscal years 2016 to 2025), with the cases inside a multidistrict litigation counted apart and every civil case the district received that year. Counted from the Federal Judicial Center's civil case file.
